description: Introducing PEPEPACKS - Series 1 of the Rare Pepe Collection brought into the physical world! 150 10 year anniversary Pepe packs are available with hit favorites such as RAREPEPE, HAIRPEPE, LORDKEK, and more! This set is an unofficial Pepe product created for the enjoyment of having physical Pepe cards in the world. Available for pickup at the Bitcoin 2026 conference in Las Vegas. Message @TrustyPinocchio on X for more information.
